title: Writing Task 2 - Elderly Care
description: IELTS Writing Task 2: Who should be responsible for caring for the elderly — family or the state?

stimuli.title: Task 2: Responsibility for Caring for the Elderly
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

In many countries, the proportion of elderly people is increasing rapidly. Some people argue that families should take responsibility for looking after their elderly relatives, while others believe this is a duty of the state. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

questionGroups.instruction: Write an essay discussing whether families or the state should be responsible for elderly care.

questions.content: Discuss whether families or the state should bear responsibility for caring for the elderly.

bandDescriptors.taskResponse: Present both perspectives fairly and offer a nuanced personal opinion supported by evidence
bandDescriptors.coherence: Transition smoothly between family-centred and state-centred arguments
bandDescriptors.lexicalResource: Use social care vocabulary: aged care facilities, filial duty, pension system, social welfare
bandDescriptors.grammaticalRange: Use modal verbs for obligation and possibility, and complex adverbial clauses

sampleIdeas: Family care preserves emotional bonds and cultural values around respect for elders
Working adults face time and financial constraints that make full-time family care difficult
State-funded care homes provide professional medical attention that families cannot provide
A hybrid model combining family support and state assistance may be the most practical solution
